Server API

group REMOTE_PROVISIONING_SERVER_API

Functions declaration.

Functions

bool rmt_prov_server_reg(uint8_t element_index)

Register remote provisioning server model.

参数:

element_index -- [in] Element index that model is registered to.

返回值:

  • true -- Registration success.

  • false -- Registration failed. Verify parameters.

返回:

Registration status.

void rmt_prov_server_set_cb(model_data_cb_pf pcb)

Set model data callback for the server.

参数:

pcb -- [in] Callback function for model data.

bool rmt_prov_server_set_capabilities(uint8_t max_scanned_items, rmt_prov_active_scan_state_t active_scan_state)

Set remote provisioning server capabilities.

参数:

  • max_scanned_items -- [in] Maximum number of scanned items.

  • active_scan_state -- [in] Active scan state.

返回值:

  • true -- Capabilities set successfully.

  • false -- Capabilities set failed. Check parameters.

返回:

Capability set status.

void rmt_prov_server_scan_stop(void)

Stop the scanning process on the server.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t rmt_prov_scan_report(uint16_t dst, uint16_t net_key_index, int8_t rssi, uint8_t uuid[16], uint8_t oob[2], uint8_t uri_hash[4])

Report scan information from the server.

参数:

  • dst -- [in] Destination address for scan report.

  • net_key_index -- [in] Network key index used for the report.

  • rssi -- [in] Received signal strength indicator.

  • uuid -- [in] UUID value received.

  • oob -- [in] Out-of-band value received.

  • uri_hash -- [in] URI hash value received.

返回值:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Successfully sent.

  • Others -- Transmission failed. Validate parameters.

返回:

Send status.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t rmt_prov_extended_scan_report(uint16_t dst, uint16_t net_key_index, rmt_prov_status_t status, uint8_t uuid[16], uint8_t oob[2], uint8_t adv_data[], uint8_t adv_data_len)

Report extended scan information from the server.

参数:

  • dst -- [in] Destination address for extended scan report.

  • net_key_index -- [in] Network key index used for the report.

  • status -- [in] Extended scan status.

  • uuid -- [in] UUID value received.

  • oob -- [in] Out-of-band value received.

  • adv_data -- [in] Advertisement data scanned.

  • adv_data_len -- [in] Length of advertisement data scanned.

返回值:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Successfully sent.

  • Others -- Transmission failed. Check parameters.

返回:

Send status.

void rmt_prov_server_handle_udb(uint8_t bt_addr[6], uint8_t bt_addr_type, int8_t rssi, beacon_udb_t *pudb, uint8_t len)

Handle unprovisioned device beacon on the server.

参数:

  • bt_addr -- [in] Bluetooth address of the device.

  • bt_addr_type -- [in] Type of Bluetooth address.

  • rssi -- [in] Received signal strength indication.

  • pudb -- [in] UDB information.

  • len -- [in] Length of UDB information.

void rmt_prov_server_handle_prov(uint8_t bt_addr[6], uint8_t bt_addr_type, int8_t rssi, mesh_service_data_t *pservice_data, uint8_t len)

Handle provisioning service from the server.

参数:

  • bt_addr -- [in] Bluetooth address of the device.

  • bt_addr_type -- [in] Type of Bluetooth address.

  • rssi -- [in] Received signal strength indication.

  • pservice_data -- [in] Provisioning service information.

  • len -- [in] Length of service data.

void rmt_prov_server_handle_conn_state_change(uint8_t conn_id, uint8_t new_state, uint16_t disc_cause)

Handle connection state change from the server.

参数:

  • conn_id -- [in] Connection identifier.

  • new_state -- [in] New state of the connection.

  • disc_cause -- [in] Reason for disconnection.

void rmt_prov_server_handle_mtu_info(uint8_t conn_id, uint16_t mtu_size)

Handle MTU information from the server.

参数:

  • conn_id -- [in] Connection identifier.

  • mtu_size -- [in] MTU size.

Get remote provisioning procedure from the server.

返回:

Current remote provisioning procedure.

void rmt_prov_handle_timeout_dev(void *ptimer)

Handle provisioning timeout for a device.

参数:

ptimer -- [in] Timer handle.

void rmt_prov_server_extended_scan_handle(gap_sched_adv_report_type_t adv_report_type, uint8_t bt_addr[6], uint8_t addr_type, int8_t rssi, uint8_t *pbuffer, uint16_t buf_len)

Handle extended scan data from the server.

参数:

  • addr_type -- [in] Type of Bluetooth address.

  • rssi -- [in] Received signal strength indication.

  • pbuffer -- [in] Scan response data.

  • buf_len -- [in] Length of scan response data.

Close link on the server.

Handle network key deletion on the server.

参数:

net_key_index -- [in] Network key local index.

void rmt_prov_scanned_items_clear(void)

Clear scanned items on the server.

void rmt_prov_node_reset(void)

Reset remote provision node from the server.

void prov_init_rmt(void)

Initialize remote provision from the server.
